ONLY PEOPLE WHO SUPPLY A RESUME WILL BE CONSIDERED!

Vacancy address: NFR Holdings PTY LTD is seeking for experienced Peoples Performance Department Managers to join the team at McDonald's Restaurants at the locations in Mackay, 4740 QLD and surrounding regional areas.

Vacancy address Mackay, 4740 QLD and surrounding regional areas:

102 Shakespeare Street, East Mackay, Queensland 4740

23-39 Oak Street, Andergrove QLD 4740

Work type: Full time- 38h/week

Tenancy: Position is available full time 38/h per week

Salary: $80,000

Qualifications & Experience:

AQF Diploma and minimum one year of relevant work experience or at least three years of experience if no formal qualifications.

Position Summary

The People & Performance Department Manager is responsible for planning, directing and coordinating workforce capability development, operational performance systems and staff engagement initiatives within a high-volume restaurant environment operating on a 24-hour basis.

The role integrates responsibilities across workforce development, operational performance monitoring, facilities coordination, safety compliance and inventory management, ensuring the restaurant maintains high operational standards and staff capability.

Operating within a franchised hospitality environment, the position focuses on improving staff performance, operational efficiency, service standards and workplace culture, while ensuring compliance with organisational policies and operational procedures.

This is a managerial role responsible for coordinating operational systems, staff capability development and performance improvement initiatives, rather than routine supervisory duties.

Key Responsibilities

Workforce Development and Staff Performance

• Design and implement structured staff training programs to ensure employees meet operational and customer service standards.

• Conduct internal workshops with Crew Coach teams and key crew members to support new product launches and ensure consistent procedures and product quality.

• Promote a high-performance workplace culture through mentoring, coaching and professional development initiatives.

• Monitor staff capability development and implement improvement strategies to enhance operational productivity.

• Promote the organisation’s open-door communication policy and support staff engagement initiatives.

Operational Performance and Business Analysis

• Analyse restaurant sales performance including product demand, store operational segments, service periods and seasonal activity to identify operational improvement opportunities.

• Develop operational strategies designed to improve efficiency, maximise production capacity and reduce operational downtime.

• Prepare operational reports and performance analysis for the Restaurant Manager, Licensee and Head Office.

• Support implementation of operational initiatives that improve productivity and service delivery.

Facilities, Equipment and Infrastructure Management

• Develop and coordinate preventative maintenance schedules for restaurant equipment and operational infrastructure.

• Conduct weekly operational walk-through inspections to identify maintenance and repair requirements.

• Coordinate repairs and maintenance activities with external contractors and service providers.

• Conduct monthly audits of IT systems and operational infrastructure to ensure functionality and compliance with organisational standards.

• Conduct quarterly audits of equipment and operational systems against company standards.

• Monitor equipment calibration systems to ensure operational accuracy and compliance.

Safety, Compliance and Risk Management

• Design and implement workplace safety training programs, including quarterly Safety Squad training initiatives.

• Monitor safety reporting systems and ensure safety compliance standards are maintained.

• Conduct periodic operational safety audits and ensure corrective actions are implemented where required.

• Ensure employees comply with workplace safety procedures and organisational policies.

Inventory and Operational Resource Management

• Oversee stock control systems and inventory procedures to ensure efficient operational supply management.

• Conduct stock audits and analyse stock usage patterns to support waste reduction initiatives.

• Coordinate inventory ordering schedules and stock delivery planning.

• Monitor storage procedures to ensure compliance with FIFO stock rotation systems and food safety standards.

• Manage procurement of operational equipment and small-ware supplies.

Quality Standards and Customer Experience

• Promote a customer-focused service culture aligned with organisational standards.

• Ensure operational procedures maintain high product quality and service consistency.

• Implement quality monitoring systems designed to support customer satisfaction and operational standards.

Leadership and Organisational Representation

• Represent the organisation at official occasions, conventions, training seminars and industry events when required.

• Support the Restaurant Manager and Licensee in implementing operational strategies and improvement initiatives.

• Act on behalf of the Restaurant Manager or Supervisor during periods of absence to ensure operational continuity.

• Prepare ad hoc operational reports and analysis for senior management when required.

Qualification and Experience Requirements

The position requires:

• AQF Diploma or higher qualification in Hospitality Management, Business Management, Retail Management, Human Resource Management or related discipline with 1 year experience

OR

• A minimum of three (3) years of relevant managerial experience within a franchised hospitality or retail environment, demonstrating responsibility for operational management, workforce development and business performance.

Professional experience gained within high-volume franchised hospitality operations may substitute for formal qualifications where the candidate can demonstrate advanced operational leadership capability.

result.description:
RJN Cua Vineyards is a horticulture-based business that primarily works with table and wine grapes. The business traditionally runs at full capacity between the months of November – May, with the additional months occupied with setting up for the next season and other tasks. 

RJN Cua Vineyards is seeking up to 20 full-time, seasonal short-term employees to join the team as a farming labourer. This role offers up to 3 years of employment in a full-time capacity. Operations will be a maximum of 12 hours per shift, with two days off per fortnight. Weekly hours will not exceed 60 hours unless external factors require. 

The location of work will be transferable between the two main sites. These sites are in the following vicinities:
-	Red Cliffs, Victoria, 3496
-	Mundubbera, Queensland, 4626
Ideally, the applicant will be located in one of the two areas. 

Peak periods are based upon location (many external factors can change these timelines):
-	QLD-based is November – February
-	VIC-based is January – May. 

As a Labourer, you will work in a diverse landscape where duties can cover the following (not limited to):

During peak periods, you will commonly be completing the following duties. 
•	Wine Grape Harvest & Maintenance
o	Assist in harvest operations day or night as required by the fruit and buyer
o	All general upkeeping duties of a wine grape vineyard (spraying, slashing, irrigation, post and trellis repair, etc)
•	Table Grape Harvest & Maintenance
o	Assist in harvest operations, which commence at 5 am, to prepare packaging requirements for fruit, conduct quality inspections, and export fruit to domestic and international markets. Prepare equipment for the Fruit Picking staff and assist with the transportation of fruit from the field to the cool rooms.
o	All general maintenance duties of a table grape vineyard (spraying, slashing, irrigation, post and trellis repair, cleaning of equipment, etc)
Other duties which may occur are:
•	Frozen Fruits
o	Handling raw product to enter production line, moving and storage of completed packaging, and cleaning of equipment
•	Almond Storage & Export
o	Handling produce and packaging as required by management, preparing for transport and export, and cleaning of storage areas
•	Additional adhoc duties as required

To be successful in this role, you need:
-	To be physically capable of repetitive movements and able to lift 10 kgs or more
-	You will also need to be able to successfully pass a police clearance check
-	Be consenting to regular drug and alcohol checks whilst onsite
-	Have an Australian driver's licence 
-	Be willing to work outside of ordinary hours. This can also include weekends, nights and public holidays
-	Be willing to commence work 
-	Have accommodation in either: Red Cliffs, Victoria or surrounds, OR Mundubbera, Queensland or surrounds

Remuneration will be as per the Horticulture Award 2020. Depending on the candidate's skill level, employees will commence on Level 1 as a full-time employee, equating to $25.74 an hour. After completing 3 months of employment (if you have not already), the successful candidate will progress to Level 2, $26.44 an hour. Overtime payments will be as per the Horticulture Award and as required. 

This role will be subject to a 6-month probationary period commencing as of the first working day for the successful candidate. 

Should you wish to proceed with your application for this role, please complete the screening questions with your completed and attached cover letter and resume.

Renowned for its authentic Indian cuisine, exceptional customer service, and welcoming dining experience, Salt Indian Cuisine serves customers from Padbury and surrounding Northern suburbs. As our business continues to grow, we are looking for a passionate and skilled Chef to join our kitchen team and contribute to delivering outstanding dining experiences for our guests.

Skills and Experience

• Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

• A positive attitude and strong teamwork skills.

What We Offer
• Full-time permanent position with a salary of $75,000 – $85,000 per annum (depending on experience).
• A supportive and friendly team environment.

With AMA Group, you can go anywhere.

 

 CAPITAL SMART

With an extensive network across Australia and New Zealand, as part of our Team, you can go anywhere.

 

ACM PARTS

ACM Parts is Australia’s largest provider of alternative and specialty parts to the automotive repair industry, keeping vehicles on the road. We are reimaging the way vehicles can be repaired by providing a choice of options that suit their needs. We offer a comprehensive range of Reclaimed, Genuine, and Aftermarket parts as. ACM Parts is reinventing the quality and service standards of the repair industry. It’s our mission to re-define and repair.

 

The Opportunity
We have an exciting opportunity for Centre Manager at either of our AMA Group Solutions or Capital S.M.A.R.T Repairs team. This is a full time position.

Mansys Pty Ltd is recruiting on behalf of Sonar Technologies International
Location: Macquarie Park, NSW
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Salary: $80,000–$90,000 plus superannuation, depending on skills and experience
About the Company
Sonar Technologies International is an Australian technology company specialising in enterprise mobility and smart business solutions.
Sonar develops and implements software products that automate operational workflows across transport and logistics, mobile workforce management, warehousing, field services, retail and healthcare. Its solutions provide capabilities such as job scheduling, dispatch management, route optimisation, real-time tracking, inventory management, reporting and integration with existing ERP and CRM platforms.
About the Role
The role will primarily involve C# and .NET application development, API integration, database-driven software solutions and the deployment of applications through modern cloud and container environments.
Key Responsibilities
•	Analyse business requirements, functional specifications and existing application workflows.
•	Develop, maintain and enhance software applications using C#, .NET and related technologies.
•	Design, develop and test APIs used to integrate Sonar applications with customer, ERP, CRM and third-party systems.
•	Write maintainable and appropriately documented program code in accordance with technical specifications and development standards.
•	Identify limitations and deficiencies in existing applications and recommend suitable software improvements.
•	Test, debug and correct application errors to ensure systems perform reliably and according to specification.
•	Assist in upgrading legacy .NET applications and APIs to current frameworks and development standards.
•	Develop and maintain database-driven functionality using SQL and relational database technologies.
•	Develop and maintain automated build, testing and deployment processes through CI/CD pipelines.
•	Assist with the deployment and operation of applications in cloud environments such as Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure or AWS.
•	Monitor application performance, investigate runtime issues and implement software-level fixes.
•	Develop internal utilities and automation tools using technologies such as Python, Go, PowerShell or Bash.
•	Prepare and maintain technical documentation, deployment instructions and operational procedures.
•	Work with software architects, developers, project teams and support personnel throughout the software development lifecycle.
Qualifications and Experience
•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering or a closely related discipline.
•	At least one year of relevant software development or closely related commercial experience.
•	Practical experience developing applications or APIs using C# and .NET.
•	Experience with REST APIs and system integration.
•	Familiarity with cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure or AWS.
•	Familiarity with CI/CD tools and source-control platforms such as Bitbucket or Git.
Desirable Skills
•	Experience modernising legacy .NET applications.
•	Experience developing software for logistics, workforce management, warehousing, healthcare or other operational environments.
•	Knowledge of real-time data processing, GPS, mobile applications, reporting systems or ERP/CRM integration.
•	Experience with Python, Go, PowerShell or Bash scripting.
•	Understanding of application monitoring tools and cloud-based observability
•	Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.

Location: Kununurra, Western Australia (East Kimberley)
Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing (38 hours per week)

About Us

Coral Coast Distributors (Cairns) Pty Ltd is a privately owned retail and distribution business supplying household goods and everyday essentials throughout the East Kimberley region of Western Australia.

We operate retail stores that service regional and remote communities, with a strong focus on customer service, operational excellence and community engagement. We value teamwork, accountability and continuous improvement, and offer stable, long-term employment opportunities within a growing regional business.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Retail Supervisor to oversee the day-to-day operations of our retail store in Kununurra.

This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for supervising staff, coordinating daily store operations, maintaining merchandising and presentation standards, managing stock and cash handling processes, and delivering exceptional customer service.

The successful applicant will be capable of working independently, leading by example and contributing to the continued success of our regional retail operations.

Salary: $69,000 per annum plus superannuation.

Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities
Supervise the day-to-day operation of the retail store in accordance with company policies and procedures.
Lead, coach and support Retail Assistants to achieve high standards of customer service and operational performance.
Coordinate staff rosters and assist with onboarding and training of new employees.
Deliver exceptional customer service and resolve customer enquiries and complaints professionally.
Process retail sales using POS and EFTPOS systems.
Complete daily cash reconciliation, banking and cash handling procedures.
Receive, check and organise incoming stock deliveries.
Maintain stock levels, conduct stocktakes and monitor inventory accuracy.
Ensure visual merchandising and store presentation standards are maintained.
Maintain a clean, safe and well-organised workplace.
Process customer returns and refunds in accordance with company procedures.
Complete store reporting, administrative tasks and timesheets accurately and on time.
Use POS, inventory management and Microsoft Office software to support store operations.
Skills and Experience
Minimum two years' experience in a retail supervisory or retail management position.
Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate staff within a retail environment.
Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.
Experience with cash handling, banking and reconciliation procedures.
Sound computer skills, including Microsoft Office and POS systems.
Strong organisational and time-management skills with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability to communicate effectively with customers, colleagues and management.
Willingness to work a rotating roster, including weekends where required.
Commitment to working respectfully with people from diverse cultural backgrounds.
Willingness to live and work in Kununurra, a regional location in the East Kimberley.
Desirable
Experience working in regional or remote retail environments.
Experience using inventory management and stock control systems.
Current First Aid Certificate (desirable but not essential).
Pre-Employment Requirements
National Police Check (acceptable outcome).
Valid right to work in Australia, or willingness to participate in an employer-sponsored visa program where eligible.
How to Apply

Please submit your resume together with a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience and suitability for the position.

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Boston Scientific
Principal Clinical Specialist - Electrophysiology
Melbourne, Victoria

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our elite sales team is made up of passionate, dedicated professionals, delivering the most advanced medical technologies to patients in need. By collaborating extensively with leading healthcare professionals you’ll see first-hand the impact you have on individual lives - one patient at a time. 

The position of Principal Clinical Specialist, Electrophysiology, provides field/remote clinical education, technical sales insights and support to team members and assigned accounts across ANZ.

WHAT WILL YOU BE RESPONSIBLE FOR?

Technical Leadership and Clinical Expertise
•	Utilise in depth knowledge of cardiac devices and full BSC device portfolio to support customer adoption, troubleshoot complex cases, maintain legacy product knowledge and identify opportunities to expand product utilisation.
•	Be the lead resource and trusted advisor for customer and implant queries, maintaining current knowledge of Boston Scientific products, competitive technologies, and evolving market practices to support informed customer decision-making.
•	Provide clinical support including patient education, device programming, and follow-up, plus technical application and site coordination, ensuring customers receive appropriate support throughout the product life cycle.
•	Lead technical discussions relating to product performance, clinical outcomes, workflow optimisation, and technology integration within customer accounts.
•	Attend cases face to face (or remotely) with customers, operate Boston Scientific products where appropriate, and provide detailed training and advice to physicians on clinical attributes and techniques associated with Boston Scientific products.
•	Build strong hospital relationships and ensure product use aligns with Directions for Use.
•	Provide proctoring to team and customers for early cases to build competence and confidence.
•	Be the lead resource for cardiac devices, troubleshoot complex cases, and maintain legacy product knowledge.

Strategic Customer Engagement
•	Drive adoption of new technologies and act as product champion during product launches, supporting customer education and utilisation growth across strategic accounts.
•	Respond to complex customer needs and complaints regarding products and service by developing creative and feasible solutions or working with other related personnel (e.g., sales, clinical, research, marketing, technical support) to develop optimal solutions.
•	Develop and execute account specific technical engagement plans in partnership with Territory Managers and Sales Leadership to support revenue growth and market penetration objectives.
•	Organise and attend targeted 1:1 customer meetings to explore product utilisation, customer expectations, emerging clinical needs and opportunities to explore adoption.
•	Identify cross-divisional innovation opportunities, share relevant information, and liaise with the global team to resolve customer complaints, ensuring effective communication with physicians throughout the resolution process.
•	Attend meetings, conferences, and exhibitions as required to promote Boston Scientific products and services. Participate in planning and presenting at sales meetings.
•	Follow up with customers after product implementation, training and clinical support activities to ensure satisfaction, address concerns
•	Monitor customer feedback, changing customer requirements and competitor activity, sharing relevant market insights with commercial leadership and cross-functional teams to support business planning and customer engagement strategies.

Leadership and Collaboration
•	Be recognised as a national leader, fostering collaboration and best practice sharing.
•	Work closely with the education team to design and enact in-field training programs that enhance clinical capability and address training gaps.
•	Assume responsibility for training competency check lists.
•	Assist in creating and delivering internal and external training, support certifications to meet national standards, and oversee regular sharing of relevant journal articles.
•	Collaborate to identify clinical efficiencies and engagement opportunities.
•	Provide coverage for complex cases and support the ANZ business as needed.

Operations
•	Optimise utilisation of stock nearing expiry, coordinate timely returns, and maintain appropriate inventory levels aligned with customer case mix requirements.
•	Record customer information and activities in company’s CRM system and use the system as an alignment tool with other commercial roles.
•	Ensure timely collection and reporting of all required medical documentation pertaining to procedural device operation.
•	Once certified (partial or full), take part in the on-call roster and support the team after hours and on weekends when rostered on call.
•	Travel as required to meet customer demand for the services described above.
 
KEY COMPETENCIES REQUIRED FOR SUCCESS

Product/Technical Knowledge
Functional Knowledge 
Business Expertise 
Relationship Building 
Leadership 
Impact 
Results Focused
Problem Solving 
Organisation & Reporting
Interactions (and Communications)

E-Commerce Roles
Trading under Publicis Media Australia  
Location: Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane
E-Commerce Manager (also known as E-Commerce Performance Manager, Commerce Manager)
Role Overview 
This role is responsible for planning and implementing eCommerce initiatives on platforms/marketplaces such as Amazon, eBay, Citrus, Facebook, and Google (+others). Utilise your in-depth knowledge in Performance Media/eCommerce and Paid Search, and you will be responsible for implementing best-in-class digital performance campaigns. The role involves the management of both eCommerce content and media initiatives for our clients.

Skills & Experience
•	This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 3+ years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. 
•	Owns performance process from Activate (Buying & Trafficking) to Convert (Optimisation & Reporting) and works with the eCommerce Director and PGD associate to execute.
•	Fluent in the fundamentals of campaign set-up/optimisation and reporting across PPC (Google Ads, Shopping Ads, Amazon Search Console, CitrusAd), paid social (Meta) and programmatic (Amazon DSP) + others.
•	Oversees the work of the PGD associate. Communicates with clients on reporting, competitive and creative specs requirements
•	Ensures all budget lines of performance campaigns are set up correctly and paced to the goal
•	Ensures finance is completed with 100 % accuracy
•	Creates a positive relationship with key media/tech partners (e.g. Google, Meta, Cartology, Coles 360, Amazon and eBay + others).
•	Forms an effective relationship with the eCommerce Director and works well with other team members
•	Files all proformas, MBAs, IOs and media plans.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
•	Intermediate excel and Microsoft office skills are a must
•	Intermediate to advanced certification of Google Ads (Paid Search) and Amazon Sponsored Ads. Will undertake Amazon DSP certification within 3 months in the role. 
•	BCC training Proficient in spot entry, knowledge of correct digital codes to use, and ability to run Expenditure/Invoice reports. Completed Digital Compliance training. Learn how to solve Account Queries within 48 hours of receiving an email notification.
•	Contributes to competitive work during new business pitches.
Salary: $90K - $110K package 

E-Commerce Director (also known as E-Commerce Performance Director, Commerce Director)

Role Overview 
The purpose of the Ecommerce Director role is to manage the growing marketplace ecommerce offering at Publicis agencies across Australia and New Zealand. This role is responsible for the strategy and implementation of ecommerce initiatives on platforms/marketplaces such as Amazon, eBay, Citrus, Facebook, and Google. The role involves management of both ecommerce content and media initiatives for Groupe clients. Reporting to the National Head of Digital & Data/Head of Digital/Head of E Commerce, the role exists to accelerate the growth of ecommerce business. This role will have an opportunity to develop the offering and work across global hubs on best practice implementation of content and media strategies in marketplace ecommerce. There is tremendous opportunity of growth in the role with a hugely exciting and rapidly growing team.

Skills & Output
•	Create and implement effective ecommerce campaigns across platforms/marketplaces (specifically Amazon, Google, Facebook, eBay, Citrus + others) that deliver high-quality results. 
•	Develop audits, scorecards and use data to identify optimisation opportunities, including keyword research, budgeting and make recommendations regarding media and advertising opportunities. 
•	Develop audits, scorecards and use research and data to improve brand presence, SEO/REO (including detail page optimisation) across ecommerce marketplaces. 
•	Manage Seller/Vendor Central operations, such as account health checks, pricing strategy recommendations and product reviews analysis. 
•	Remain across ecommerce industry trends, compile data into client-facing collateral and use the information to adapt existing campaign strategies relevant to each brand. 
•	Participate in new business opportunities as they pertain to marketplace ecommerce – commercially and strategically. 
•	Actively engage in the collaboration effort between the Groupe agencies and the Product practice

EXPERIENCE: 
•	Previous experience in a similar role in Performance Media/eCommerce working across paid search as well as either eRetail platforms like CitrusAd or Amazon + others 
•	Must have an excellent grasp of Performance Media (planning and buying) 
•	Must have experience and working knowledge of performance media platforms – From Ad servers to DSPs/Bid Management Platforms, Analytics, Ad Verification Technology and Audience Planning Tools. 
•	Strong team management and leadership skills. Has proven abilities in mentoring, training and developing high performing teams.
•	Strong communication skills (written and verbal). Can confidently present, and construct well-substantiated digital media strategies.
Salary: $110K - $140K package 

•	All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification with 2 or more years’ experience in a similar role OR a minimum of 5 years relevant work experience in lieu of qualification.
•	Roles could also be available in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane

Position: Retail Store Manager
Location: Gold Coast Pacific Fair – Pacific Fair Shopping Centre, 2–30 Hooker Boulevard, Broadbeach QLD 4218?
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time?
Hours: 38 hours per week?
Salary: AUD $85,000–$90,000 per annum, plus superannuation

This advertisement is posted by Comandini Migration Services on behalf of Golden Goose Australia Pty Ltd.

About Us
Golden Goose Australia Pty Ltd is a premium fashion retailer specialising in luxury sneakers, clothing, footwear, bags and accessories. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality products and exceptional customer service.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Retail Store Manager to lead our store operations, drive sales growth and deliver a world-class customer experience. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving commercial objectives, managing and developing the store team, maintaining brand and visual merchandising standards, and ensuring the efficient operation of the store.
This role requires a reliable, empowering and supportive leader with strong commercial awareness, excellent communication skills and proven experience managing a premium retail environment.

Key Responsibilities
Sales and Customer Experience
* Manage store sales targets and monitor performance through relevant key performance indicators.
* Develop and implement action plans in consultation with the Area Manager to improve sales performance.
* Lead and motivate the team to achieve commercial targets while maintaining high customer service standards.
* Ensure employees consistently follow the company’s selling processes, including up-selling, cross-selling and promoting available services.
* Provide customers with accurate information regarding products, pricing, services and expected timeframes.
* Build strong customer relationships through personalised service and regular follow-up.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement initiatives to improve customer satisfaction.
* Build relationships with the local community and act as a brand ambassador to attract new customers and retain existing clients.
* Manage customer database development, segmentation and profiling.
* Drive in-store and omnichannel sales by effectively using available systems, tools and technology.

Business and Network Development
* Support the Area Manager in developing long-term market growth strategies.
* Establish and maintain commercial relationships and partnerships within the local market.
* Monitor relevant retail and industry trends.
* Identify and recommend sales opportunities and business development initiatives.

Brand and Product Management
* Represent and promote the company’s brand values, heritage and vision.
* Ensure employees have a strong understanding of the brand, products and services.
* Monitor the store’s product assortment and provide feedback to Area Management and the Buying Team regarding customer and market demand.
* Oversee the overall presentation of the store.
* Maintain high visual merchandising and product display standards in accordance with company guidelines.
* Ensure the team remains informed and trained on all product collections and categories.
Team Leadership and Human Resources
* Recruit, manage, develop, motivate and empower store employees.
* Build a positive and supportive workplace culture based on trust, professionalism and accountability.
* Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, training and performance development.
* Conduct daily and weekly store briefings to communicate objectives, priorities and sales strategies.
* Support new employees throughout the onboarding process.
* Ensure employees comply with company grooming and uniform standards.
* Work closely with the Area Manager and Human Resources team to recruit suitable employees.
* Manage employee performance and implement appropriate improvement measures where required.
* Prepare staff rosters and ensure appropriate staffing levels are maintained.

Store Operations and Compliance
* Supervise and coordinate all store activities to ensure efficient daily operations.
* Ensure compliance with the company’s standard operating procedures.
* Oversee stock and back-of-house operations, including receiving and transferring stock, stocktaking, stock control, storage, reporting and store administration.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, governance requirements, privacy obligations, workplace health and safety requirements and other applicable regulations.
* Use relevant retail, customer relationship management and point-of-sale systems.
* Ensure employees are appropriately trained in all operational and digital systems.

Skills and Experience
The successful candidate will have:
* Relevant experience managing a retail store or comparable retail operation.
* Demonstrated experience leading, developing and motivating a retail team.
* Strong knowledge of retail sales, customer service and store operations.
* Proven ability to achieve sales targets and manage key performance indicators.
* Experience in stock management, visual merchandising and operational compliance.
* Strong commercial awareness and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, leadership and interpersonal skills.
* The ability to build strong relationships with customers, employees and business stakeholders.
* Experience using point-of-sale, customer relationship management and other retail management systems.
* The ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Experience in premium, luxury or fashion retail will be highly regarded.
